title: Hang initialising org.apache.lucene.index.BaseTermsEnum

labels.name: :Search/Search
labels.description: Search-related issues that do not fall into other categories

labels.name: Team:Search Relevance
labels.description: Meta label for the Search Relevance team in Elasticsearch

body:
This initialisation hang has been observed. I would expect it to be quite infrequent, but ultimately fatal. See Lucene issue https://github.com/apache/lucene/issues/15317.

The static `TermsEnum.EMPTY` initialises to an implementation of `BaseTermsEnum`. `TermsEnum` is a superclass of `BaseTermsEnum`, so there is a clear dependency between these classes. If a subclass of `BaseTermsEnum` is initialising it may grab the lock on `BaseTermsEnum`, and prevent `TermsEnum` from initialising. 

The workaround is to ensure that `TermsEnum` is initialized early before subclasses are loaded/initialized.

Example:
